usb.title: USB printer
usb.description: Select a connected USB printer. The integration will verify that it speaks the Epson LabelWorks protocol.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth serial printer
bluetooth.description: Pair the printer on the host and expose it as an RFCOMM serial device first.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the printer or read its status
error.no_usb_devices: No USB devices were found. Connect the printer and check Home Assistant's USB permissions, then try again.
error.usb_device_unavailable: The selected USB device is no longer available. Try again to refresh the list.
error.usb_discovery_failed: USB devices could not be detected. Check Home Assistant's USB permissions.
